name: VDI Rendering by Raycasting
aliases: VDI Rendering by Raycasting — NDC Space Raycasting, Voxel Stepping
definition: A raycasting method that computes supersegment intersections in the Normalized Device Coordinate (NDC) space of the original view $V_0$, where supersegments and lists are cuboids, enabling voxel stepping traversal.
summary: VDI Rendering by Raycasting renders volumetric depth images by traversing a regular NDC grid of supersegment lists, avoiding explicit geometry generation for efficient scaling.
